skills.desc:
Water type blunt attack on a single enemy (XL) and Power of user +50% and Speed of user +50% (3 turns)
* When enemy has an active buff:
** Removes all buffs from target
** Power and Speed effect increases (100%)
** When not in Clock Burst State: Stacks 5 Pendulum on user
* Grant Kaleido to user; change element of user attacks to target's Weak element (permanent)
** When multiple Weak - choice is random.
** Non-type attacks become elemental without change in skill multiplier
** Skills from equipment also change
** Effect is based on when skill was used
*** If Weak to the selected element is removed, skill needs to be reused in order to detect a new Weak (if there is any)
